name: refinitiv-macro-terminal
description: Bloomberg-style static terminal for Refinitiv macro data (US, Indonesia, China) plus US Reuters Polls

scripts.ingest:us: python scripts/extract_observations.py --country us && python scripts/extract_rics.py --country us
scripts.ingest:id: python scripts/extract_observations.py --country id && python scripts/extract_rics.py --country id
scripts.ingest:cn: python scripts/extract_observations.py --country cn && python scripts/extract_rics.py --country cn
scripts.graph: python scripts/build_graph.py --country us && python scripts/build_graph.py --country id && python scripts/build_graph.py --country cn
